long_biography.plain_text:
Matteo Rigamonti built Weerg around a problem he encountered when ordering custom components: suppliers were slow to quote, delivery dates were uncertain and disputes over remade parts dragged on. He decided that industrial production should be ordered through a website with clear prices, tolerances and delivery times.

Weerg opened in 2015 with instant online quotations and in-house quality control for CNC machining. Rigamonti added additive manufacturing when industrial 3D-printing equipment became commercially viable, then concentrated production in an automated facility at Scorzè. He remains founder and president, overseeing a manufacturing platform that combines software-driven ordering with continuous production of metal and polymer parts.
